parsed_json.up: Return approved drugs indicated for acute myeloid leukemia. Select ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, EFO ID, indication label, and max phase for indication. Source from molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, and drug_indication. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter for max_phase equal to 4. Filter for mesh_heading equal to 'Acute Myeloid Leukemia'. Sort by ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, EFO ID, indication label, and max phase for indication in ascending order.
